caption: Each box is one pass: it clips the vertex list against that boundary and hands the new list down. Follow the lists shrinking until the last box gives the clipped square (1,1), (3,1), (3,3), (1,3).

spec.title: Sutherland–Hodgman passes on the square (0,0) (4,0) (4,4) (0,4)
spec.aria: A downward chain of four clipping passes, left at x = 1, right at x = 3, bottom at y = 1, top at y = 3, each showing the vertex list it outputs, ending in the clipped square with vertices (1,1), (3,1), (3,3) and (1,3).
